summary: Taken ill before election day: You are in the hospital days before the polls open, and {campaign manager} asks what the campaign says.
realLife: Running in a 1937 special House election, he was rushed to an Austin hospital with appendicitis about a day and a half before the polls opened, and won with under a third of the vote.
gates: The health record puts you in the hospital (never authored).
choices: let {household member} speak for you at the final rally
put out a statement from the bed
tell {campaign manager} to keep it quiet
